acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Slimes family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Devourer, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Skeleton-Cage Champion (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two water construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Towering humanoid mass with a full posed skeleton and absorbed armor plates suspended in place.
Signature mechanic: Borrowed Frame: the full skeleton locks into one of three poses and absorbed armor plates float onto its load-bearing bones.
battlefieldDuty: Control space by posing its suspended skeleton as a brace, cage, or striking frame.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and route pressure around the existing core; T3–T4 preserve their source-supported humanoid crust frame; T5 alone retains its dozen cores in valved chambers.
Coherent clear-water channels, wet reflection, misted pressure vents, membrane valves, and visible drainage distinguish engineered Water affinity from native jelly.
counterplay: Break the unplated pivot bone during commitment to collapse the pose and expose the core. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and expose one core after pressure loss; T3–T4 expose a humanoid crust joint when a valve drains; T5 exposes one of its dozen cores as each chamber empties.
identityInvariants: Rounded, drooping, gravity-obeying jelly with surface-tension edges and a readable internal core remains the family silhouette.
Translucent blue, acid green, amber, or violet is chosen per individual, with suspended debris and a brighter but bounded core.
Viscous flow, drip trails, swallowed objects, crystalline cores, and later crust plates remain spatially coherent.
Internal structure emerges by tier: pseudopod, debris-bearing blob, humanoid crust frame, suspended skeleton, then a multicore tide.
telegraph: Bones rotate into alignment and matching armor plates click toward them through the jelly.
